global.criterion: Coherent rounded sculpted cartoon3D with credible earth/plant/materials and warm off-white background; consistent with supplied reference.
No letters, text, numbers, arrows, logos or fake writing; all exact overlays will be separate.
All relevant objects complete inside frame, generous readable spacing, no people or dangerous operation.

s105-still-zones.criterion: One connected field has a genuinely lower damp/standing-water area and a higher slope, not arbitrary equal strips.
A small isolated bare patch remains separate; no contamination or fertility diagnosis is claimed.
A genuinely small irregular bare patch at the far back is surrounded by normal plants, separate from general wet/higher areas; the old large rectangular tilled bed is gone.

s105-still-depth.criterion: Shallow selected surface layer and core distinguish sampling interval from complete roots; no exact generated ruler or unit.
Exactly three separated blank comparison cards beside the soil cutaway, no marks or baked numbers.
Entire central sampling core/sleeve ends at the lower edge of the shallow highlighted upper band; NO part extends below that band, while full roots continue below it.

overlayGate: Pixel inspect before mapping. Deterministic point IDs P01–P10 must be ten distinct locations within intended zone and outside excluded features; W is not randomization. Separate example counts at least8,10–15,training10/0–15cm;20acres≈8.09ha, no feddan substitution.
